Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 21 September 2026 21 September 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 14 September 2026 to 18 September 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 14 Sep 2026 633,000 284.0000 274.4000 278.7039 LSE 15 Sep 2026 633,000 280.3000 273.3000 276.4087 LSE 16 Sep 2026 468,000 309.2000 289.7000 301.9915 LSE 17 Sep 2026 468,000 316.5000 304.7000 311.1451 LSE 18 Sep 2026 468,000 314.2000 305.0000 310.8097 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 22,823,834 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,387,696,419 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,387,696,419.
